name: The 1/3rd HAKUBA Luxury Villa
nameZh: 白馬五龍 The 1/3rd HAKUBA 豪華別墅
location: 白馬五龍 Toomi Slope · Ski-in/Ski-out
descriptionZh: 坐落於白馬五龍滑雪場 Toomi Slope 雪道旁的頂級豪華別墅，2025年12月盛大開幕。真正實現 Ski-in/Ski-out——推開大門即是銀白雪道，無需等待、無需接駁。挑高6米中庭客廳、全景落地窗、開放式頂級廚房，盡攬北阿爾卑斯山壯麗雪景。4臥室（King/Double/Semi-double/Tatami）、4衛浴（含浴缸2套），提供24小時禮賓、私廚到府、車站接送、滑雪教學等全方位豪華服務。年租金收益率達8.8–10.5%，白馬村地價2025年漲幅高居全日本第一（+32.4%）。
descriptionEn: Perched beside the Toomi Slope at Hakuba Goryu, The 1/3rd HAKUBA opened in December 2025 as Hakuba's first true ski-in/ski-out luxury villa. Step outside and you're on the snow — no buses, no queues. A 6-metre atrium living room, panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows, and a fully-equipped designer kitchen frame breathtaking views of the North Alps. 4 bedrooms (King, Double, Semi-double, Tatami), 4 bathrooms (2 with bathtubs). Full suite of services: 24-hr concierge, private chef, station transfers, ski instruction, and equipment assistance. Gross rental yield 8.8–10.5%. Hakuba land prices rose 32.4% in 2025 — No.1 in all of Japan.

name: Slopefront Villa
descriptionZh: 白馬村最頂級的滑雪道直通別墅，從臥室一步踏上粉雪斜坡。開放式廚房、設計師家具、大面積山景窗景，提供無與倫比的白馬生活體驗。
descriptionEn: From bed to powder snow, mere steps away. The finest ski-in/ski-out villa in Hakuba Village, featuring an open-plan kitchen, designer furniture, and floor-to-ceiling mountain views.
highlight: 五竜 Toomi 滑雪道直通

name: Slopefront Villa 2
descriptionZh: 延續第一棟的卓越品質，Slopefront Villa 2 規格再升級，提供更寬敞的居住空間與私人溫泉設施，打造白馬最奢華的度假體驗。
descriptionEn: The next evolution of Slopefront Villa. Larger, more refined, and featuring a private onsen — the most luxurious ski-in/ski-out experience in Hakuba.
highlight: 私人溫泉 · 即將推出

name: 1/3rd Village
descriptionZh: 白馬村首個頂級度假村型開發項目，提供多元化戶型選擇。結合精品飯店設施與私人住宅的靈活性，是投資與自用的絕佳選擇。
descriptionEn: Hakuba's first luxury resort-style development. A curated collection of residences combining the best of boutique hotel amenities with private ownership flexibility.

name: Etranger 18 Akihabara
nameZh: 千代田外神田複合大樓
location: 東京都千代田區外神田三丁目 · 秋葉原
descriptionZh: 坐落於千代田區外神田，秋葉原商圈核心地帶。2023年竣工新築9層RC造複合大樓，延床面積457.89㎡，涵蓋店舖、事務所與住宅多元用途。鄰近JR秋葉原站、地鐵末廣町站，交通樞紐優勢突出。年總收益預估達4,700萬日圓，是千代田區稀缺的核心優質資產。
descriptionEn: Located in the heart of Akihabara, Chiyoda-ku. A 9-storey RC-construction mixed-use building completed in 2023, with a total floor area of 457.89㎡ comprising retail, office and residential units. Walking distance to JR Akihabara Station and Tokyo Metro Suehirocho Station. Estimated annual revenue of ¥47M. A rare core asset in one of Tokyo's most sought-after commercial districts.
features: 店舖・事務所・住宅複合
highlight: 秋葉原商圈核心 · 年收益¥4,700萬
highlightJa: 秋葉原中心部 · 年間収益¥4,700万

name: Narimasu Clean Heights
location: 東京都板橋區成增三丁目
descriptionZh: 位於板橋區成增三丁目的12戶RC造公寓大樓，2024年3月完成外壁大規模修繕，建物狀態優異。步行5分鐘達東武東上線「成增」站，步行7分鐘達地鐵「成増」站，快速連結池袋、新宿、澀谷。目前12戶全數出租，月租收入¥1,021,000，表面投報率4.9%，即買即收租。
descriptionEn: A 12-unit RC-structure apartment building in Narimasu, Itabashi-ku. Fully renovated exterior in March 2024. A 5-minute walk to Tobu Tojo Line Narimasu Station and 7 minutes to Tokyo Metro Narimasu Station, with direct links to Ikebukuro, Shinjuku and Shibuya. All 12 units currently tenanted. Monthly rental income ¥1,021,000. Gross yield 4.9% — immediate cash flow from day one.

name: Shibuya Tomigaya Building
location: 東京都澀谷區富谷一丁目
descriptionZh: 坐落於澀谷區富谷地帶的7層RC造商辦大樓，預計2027年3月竣工。步行4分鐘達千代田線「代代木公園」站及小田急線「代代木八幡」站，鄰近代代木公園，受益於澀谷「百年一遇」再開發利多。延床面積334.90㎡，年收益預估¥55,456,495，表面利回3.4%。
descriptionEn: A 7-storey RC office/commercial building in Tomigaya, Shibuya-ku. Estimated completion: March 2027. A 4-minute walk to Chiyoda Line Yoyogi-koen Station and Odakyu Line Yoyogi-Hachimangu Station. Adjacent to Yoyogi Park and positioned to benefit from Shibuya's landmark redevelopment. Total floor area 334.90㎡. Estimated annual revenue ¥55.5M, gross yield 3.4%.
features: 澀谷百年一遇再開發受惠
highlight: 澀谷再開發核心受益 · 2027預定竣工
highlightJa: 渋谷再開発の恩恵 · 2027年竣工予定

name: Pratique Kiyosumiteien
nameZh: 清澄白河 Pratique 清澄庭園
location: 東京都江東區清澄白河
descriptionZh: 2026年1月竣工的全新一棟收益住宅大樓，坐落於東京都江東區清澄白河。清澄白河近年以藝廊、精品咖啡與設計師品牌聚集聞名，深受年輕專業人士與國際人才青睞，租賃需求強勁。新築高規格設施，低維護成本，是追求穩定都市租金收益的優質投資標的。
descriptionEn: Newly completed in January 2026, Pratique Kiyosumiteien is a full-building income residential property in Kiyosumi-Shirakawa, Koto-ku. Known for its galleries, specialty cafés and design culture, the area draws young professionals and international residents. Premium new-build specifications with minimal maintenance costs — an ideal choice for stable urban rental income.
highlight: 2026年新築 · 清澄白河文創地帶
highlightJa: 2026年新築 · 清澄白河アート地区

name: Ueno 5-chome Building
nameZh: 台東上野五丁目複合大樓
location: 東京都台東區上野五丁目46番地6號
descriptionZh: 坐落於台東區上野五丁目的全新7層RC造複合大樓，預計2026年竣工。步行4分鐘可達東京地鐵銀座線・日比谷線「上野」站，交通極為便利。上野地區為東京東部核心商圈，觀光、零售、辦公需求旺盛。延床面積279.69㎡、地坪70.26㎡（21.25坪），新築高規格建設，是台東區稀缺的優質複合收益資產。
descriptionEn: A brand-new 7-storey RC mixed-use building in Ueno 5-chome, Taito-ku, scheduled for completion in 2026. A 4-minute walk to Tokyo Metro Ginza and Hibiya Lines at Ueno Station. Ueno is a major commercial and tourism hub in eastern Tokyo with strong retail, office and residential demand. Total floor area 279.69㎡, land area 70.26㎡ (21.25 tsubo). A rare new-build asset in a high-demand Taito-ku location.
features: 銀座線・日比谷線直結
highlightEn: 4 Min to Ueno Station · New Build RC 2026

name: SAION SAKURAZAKA #2002
location: 東京都港區赤坂一丁目 · 溜池山王
descriptionZh: 坐落於港區赤坂一丁目的26層高級塔式住宅，大林組施工、興和不動產開發，總戶數87戶。本戶位於20樓，專有面積185.44㎡（約56坪）的4LDK+WIC大坪數格局，客餐廳約29帖，西南向陽台25.20㎡，俯瞰都心天際線。2025年10月完成全室翻新（地板、壁紙、系統廚房、衛浴、熱水器、空調、門扇等全面更新），即可入住。步行2分鐘達南北線・銀座線「溜池山王」站，5分鐘達「六本木一丁目」站，坐擁赤坂・六本木・霞關核心生活圈。
descriptionEn: A 185.44㎡ (approx. 56 tsubo) 4LDK+WIC residence on the 20th floor of SAION SAKURAZAKA, a 26-storey luxury tower in Akasaka 1-chome, Minato-ku, built by Obayashi and developed by Kowa Real Estate (87 units). The approx. 29-jo living/dining room opens onto a 25.20㎡ south-west balcony with skyline views. Fully renovated in October 2025 — new flooring, wallcoverings, kitchen, bathrooms, water heater, built-in air-conditioning and doors — and ready to move in. A 2-minute walk to Tameike-Sanno Station (Namboku & Ginza Lines) and 5 minutes to Roppongi-itchome Station.
highlight: 赤坂塔式住宅 · 2025年全室翻新
highlightJa: 赤坂タワーレジデンス · 2025年フルリノベーション

name: Classy Tower Shinjuku Gyoen #3501
nameZh: 新宿御苑 Classy Tower 3501號室（頂樓）
location: 東京都新宿區四谷四丁目 · 新宿御苑前
descriptionZh: 2024年10月竣工的35層地標塔式住宅「Classy Tower 新宿御苑」，由住友商事與三菱地所Residence共同開發、鹿島建設施工，總戶數280戶。本戶位於最頂樓35樓的角間，竣工後未曾入住。專有面積157.08㎡、3LDK+2WIC+SIC，客餐廳約31.9帖並設地暖，天花板挑高達4米，大面窗正對新宿御苑綠意與新宿高樓群。飯店式內廊設計，各樓層設垃圾站。步行4分鐘達丸之內線「新宿御苑前」站。
descriptionEn: A never-occupied top-floor corner residence on the 35th floor of Classy Tower Shinjuku Gyoen, a landmark 280-unit tower completed in October 2024, developed by Sumitomo Corporation and Mitsubishi Estate Residence and built by Kajima. The 157.08㎡ 3LDK+2WIC+SIC layout features an approx. 31.9-jo living/dining room with floor heating and 4-metre ceilings, with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Shinjuku Gyoen and the Shinjuku skyline. Hotel-style interior corridors and waste stations on every floor. A 4-minute walk to Shinjuku-gyoemmae Station (Marunouchi Line).
highlight: 頂樓角間 · 新宿御苑景觀
highlightJa: 最上階角部屋 · 新宿御苑ビュー

name: Dogenzaka 1-chome Building
nameZh: 澀谷道玄坂一丁目收益大樓
location: 東京都澀谷區道玄坂一丁目 · 澀谷
descriptionZh: 位於澀谷站前道玄坂一丁目的一棟收益大樓，2015年4月新築，S・RC造地下1層・地上4層，土地115.47㎡、延床面積410.91㎡。步行1分鐘達京王井之頭線「澀谷」站、6分鐘達JR「澀谷」站，位處澀谷再開發核心區。地下1樓至2樓為餐飲店、3樓與4樓為飯店（滿室營運中），滿租年收入約¥5,529萬，表面投報率約3.3%。商業地域、容積率800%。
descriptionEn: A whole income building in Dogenzaka 1-chome, steps from Shibuya Station. Completed in April 2015; steel/reinforced-concrete, 4 storeys plus basement, on 115.47㎡ of land with 410.91㎡ total floor area. A 1-minute walk to Keio Inokashira Line Shibuya Station and 6 minutes to JR Shibuya, at the heart of Shibuya's redevelopment. Basement to 2F leased to restaurants; 3F–4F operate as a fully occupied hotel. Full-occupancy rent approx. ¥55.3M/yr; gross yield approx. 3.3%. Commercial zone, 800% floor-area ratio.
features: S・RC造 地下1層・地上4層
highlight: 澀谷站徒步1分 · 餐飲＋飯店
highlightEn: 1 Min to Shibuya Station · Dining + Hotel
highlightJa: 渋谷駅徒歩1分 · 飲食＋ホテル

name: Jiyugaoka Residence
nameZh: 自由之丘一棟收益住宅
location: 東京都目黑區自由之丘一丁目 · 自由が丘
descriptionZh: 位於人氣住宅街區目黑區自由之丘一丁目的一棟收益住宅，地下1層・地上8層RC造，共12戶（住宅10戶、店舖2戶），土地269.89㎡、延床面積817.13㎡。步行7分鐘達東急東橫線・大井町線「自由が丘」站，周邊精品選物店與雜貨店林立。2023年完成大規模修繕，並取得CASBEE不動產評價A級。目前12戶中11戶出租中（2026年9月），滿租年收入約¥4,643萬（含稅），表面投報率4.10%、NOI投報率3.51%。
descriptionEn: A 12-unit income residence (10 apartments, 2 retail units) in Jiyugaoka 1-chome, Meguro-ku — one of Tokyo's most sought-after neighbourhoods. RC construction, 8 storeys plus basement, on 269.89㎡ of land with 817.13㎡ total floor area. A 7-minute walk to Jiyugaoka Station (Tokyu Toyoko & Oimachi Lines), surrounded by boutiques and cafés. Large-scale repairs completed in 2023; CASBEE real-estate rating A. 11 of 12 units leased (Sept 2026). Full-occupancy rent approx. ¥46.4M/yr (tax incl.); gross yield 4.10%, NOI yield 3.51%.
highlight: 自由之丘一棟住宅 · 表面投報4.10%
highlightJa: 自由が丘一棟レジ · 表面利回4.10%

name: Nishi-Shinjuku Residence
location: 東京都新宿區西新宿五丁目 · 新宿副都心
descriptionZh: 位於新宿副都心西側、新宿區西新宿五丁目的13層SRC造一棟收益住宅，共49戶（1K×45戶、1LDK×3戶、店舖1區畫），土地261.71㎡、延床面積1,506.61㎡。步行3分鐘達大江戶線「西新宿五丁目」站，7分鐘達「都廳前」站，鄰近新宿中央公園與都廳商辦區，單身上班族租賃需求穩定。2026年完成入口外觀與公共空間的設計翻新。滿租年收入約¥8,855萬（未稅），表面投報率約3.1%。
descriptionEn: A 13-storey SRC income residence in Nishi-Shinjuku 5-chome, on the western edge of Shinjuku's business district: 49 units (45 × 1K, 3 × 1LDK, 1 retail unit) on 261.71㎡ of land with 1,506.61㎡ total floor area. A 3-minute walk to Nishi-Shinjuku-gochome Station and 7 minutes to Tochomae Station (Oedo Line), close to Shinjuku Central Park and the Metropolitan Government offices, with strong demand from single professionals. Entrance and common areas redesigned in 2026. Full-occupancy rent approx. ¥88.5M/yr (excl. tax); gross yield approx. 3.1%.
features: 西新宿五丁目站徒步3分
highlight: 新宿副都心 · 49戶一棟住宅
highlightJa: 新宿副都心 · 49戸一棟レジ

name: Iwamotocho Office Building
nameZh: 千代田岩本町一棟收益辦公大樓
location: 東京都千代田區岩本町二丁目 · 岩本町
descriptionZh: 位於千代田區岩本町二丁目的一棟收益辦公大樓，鋼骨造地下1層・地上8層，地下1樓至8樓共8間辦公室（7・8樓為樓中樓），土地106.77㎡、延床面積516.92㎡。步行4分鐘達都營新宿線「岩本町」站、6分鐘達日比谷線「小傳馬町」站、8分鐘達JR「神田」站，交通便利。目前由UDS進行設計師級大規模翻新，入口、各樓層電梯廳、茶水間、男女廁所與設備全面更新，預計2027年1月完工。滿租預估年收入¥4,855萬，表面投報率4.62%、NOI投報率4.12%。（室內照片為翻新完成示意圖）
descriptionEn: A whole office building in Iwamotocho 2-chome, Chiyoda-ku: steel frame, 8 storeys plus basement, with 8 office floors from B1 to 8F (7F–8F maisonette), on 106.77㎡ of land with 516.92㎡ total floor area. A 4-minute walk to Iwamotocho Station (Toei Shinjuku Line), 6 minutes to Kodemmacho (Hibiya Line) and 8 minutes to JR Kanda. A designer-led renovation by UDS — entrance, lift halls, kitchenettes, restrooms and building services — is due for completion in January 2027. Projected full-occupancy income ¥48.5M/yr; gross yield 4.62%, NOI yield 4.12%. (Interior images are renovation renderings.)
highlight: 設計師級翻新 · 表面投報4.62%
highlightJa: デザイナーズ改修 · 表面利回4.62%

name: Ebisu Residence
location: 東京都澀谷區惠比壽二丁目 · 惠比壽
descriptionZh: 2025年11月竣工的全新一棟收益住宅，位於澀谷區惠比壽二丁目。RC造地上4層，共12戶，全部為約30㎡的1LDK格局，土地約50坪、延床面積385.52㎡，已取得檢查濟證。步行9分鐘達JR山手線「惠比壽」站，13分鐘達日比谷線「廣尾」站，惠比壽・廣尾一帶單身與雙薪族群租賃需求強勁。募集租金合計月額¥274.7萬、年額¥3,296萬，表面投報率3.50%、實質投報率3.14%。
descriptionEn: A brand-new income residence completed in November 2025 in Ebisu 2-chome, Shibuya-ku. RC construction, 4 storeys, 12 units — all approx. 30㎡ 1LDK — on approx. 50 tsubo of land with 385.52㎡ total floor area; completion certificate obtained. A 9-minute walk to JR Ebisu Station (Yamanote Line) and 13 minutes to Hiroo Station (Hibiya Line), in an area with strong rental demand from singles and couples. Asking rents total ¥2.75M/month (¥32.96M/yr); gross yield 3.50%, net yield 3.14%.

name: Jingumae Retail Building
nameZh: 表參道神宮前一棟店舖大樓
location: 東京都澀谷區神宮前三丁目 · 表參道
descriptionZh: 位於澀谷區神宮前三丁目、表參道與原宿之間的一棟店舖大樓，2020年11月竣工，RC造地下1層・地上4層，共5間店舖，土地122.29㎡、延床面積359.99㎡。步行5分鐘達千代田線「明治神宮前」站，9分鐘達「表參道」站，8分鐘達JR「原宿」站，坐落於東京最具代表性的時尚商圈。目前出租中，滿租年收入約¥6,106萬（含稅），表面投報率3.12%、NOI投報率2.74%（含稅）。
descriptionEn: A whole retail building in Jingumae 3-chome, Shibuya-ku, between Omotesando and Harajuku. Completed in November 2020; RC construction, 4 storeys plus basement, 5 retail units, on 122.29㎡ of land with 359.99㎡ total floor area. A 5-minute walk to Meiji-jingumae Station (Chiyoda Line), 9 minutes to Omotesando and 8 minutes to JR Harajuku — in the heart of Tokyo's fashion district. Currently leased; full-occupancy rent approx. ¥61.1M/yr (tax incl.); gross yield 3.12%, NOI yield 2.74% (tax incl.).
features: RC造 地下1層・地上4層

name: Dubai Marina Residence
descriptionZh: 坐落於杜拜碼頭的頂級住宅，全景海灣景觀，現代化設施齊全。杜拜零稅收環境加上穩健的租金收益，是中東地產投資的首選標的。萬舍國際全程中文服務。
descriptionEn: Premium residence in Dubai Marina with panoramic bay views and state-of-the-art facilities. Dubai's zero-tax environment with strong rental yields makes this the top Middle East real estate choice.
